title: INSTA360 GO 2 — Full Diagnostic
description: Full used-camera health diagnostic before any purchase or repair. Do not reset, open, repair, buy, or modify the camera. Test only, record evidence, and submit results.

checks.title: Step 1A — Camera body
checks.instruction: Inspect body for cracks, dents, separation, impact marks or deformation. Add a note for any defect.
checks.expected_result: No structural cracks or serious impact damage.

checks.title: Step 1B — Lens
checks.instruction: Inspect lens glass closely for scratches, chips, cracks, haze or coating damage.
checks.expected_result: Lens surface is clear and undamaged.

checks.title: Step 1C — Charging contacts
checks.instruction: Inspect charging contacts on camera and case for dirt, corrosion, wear or damage.
checks.expected_result: Contacts clean, aligned and undamaged.

checks.title: Step 1D — Charging case condition
checks.instruction: Inspect charging case body, hinge, connector and seating of camera.
checks.expected_result: Case intact and camera seats correctly.

checks.title: Step 1E — Buttons/display
checks.instruction: Press buttons and verify case display/indicators respond normally.
checks.expected_result: Controls and display/indicators work normally.

checks.title: Step 1F — Power on
checks.instruction: Turn camera on normally and observe boot behaviour.
checks.expected_result: Camera powers on without repeated attempts, errors or abnormal delay.

checks.title: Step 1G — Case recognizes camera
checks.instruction: Insert camera into case and confirm recognition/charging indication.
checks.expected_result: Case detects camera reliably.

checks.title: Step 1H — Phone/app connection
checks.instruction: Connect camera to the Insta360 app on the phone. Do not reset or remove another owner account.
checks.expected_result: Phone/app connects and camera is controllable.

checks.title: Step 1I — Confirm storage
checks.instruction: Confirm whether the camera is 32GB or 64GB. Write the exact capacity in the note.
checks.expected_result: Storage capacity clearly identified as 32GB or 64GB.

checks.title: Step 1J — Overview photos
checks.instruction: Take 2–3 clear photos showing camera body, lens and charging case. Upload them here.
checks.expected_result: 2–3 clear evidence photos attached.

checks.title: Step 2 — Full charge
checks.instruction: Charge camera and case to 100%. In the note write the time both reach 100%. Do not begin battery recording until both are fully charged.
checks.expected_result: Camera and case both reach 100%; charge completion time recorded.

checks.title: Step 3 — Camera-only battery test
checks.instruction: Remove camera from case. Set Pro Video + FlowState. Start at 100% and record continuously until it automatically stops/shuts down. In the note record start time, end time, total minutes, and whether temperature was Normal / Warm / Very Hot.
checks.expected_result: Complete uninterrupted camera-only runtime recorded from 100% to automatic stop.

checks.title: Step 3B — Shutdown/heat behaviour
checks.instruction: During the camera-only battery test, note any unexpected shutdown, recording error, overheating warning or abnormal heat.
checks.expected_result: No unexpected shutdown or abnormal thermal behaviour.

checks.title: Step 4A — Charging case recharge test
checks.instruction: Put depleted camera into case. In the note record camera % before, case % before, camera % after, and case % after when charging ends.
checks.expected_result: Case meaningfully recharges the camera and charging stops normally.

checks.title: Step 4B — Second recording test
checks.instruction: After the case recharge, repeat Pro Video + FlowState continuous recording. Record the second runtime in minutes.
checks.expected_result: Second runtime measured and recorded.

checks.title: Step 5A — Daylight video
checks.instruction: Record three 20–30s clips: outdoor, walking/moving, stationary. Review sharpness, colours, exposure and stabilization. Upload a sample if useful.
checks.expected_result: Daylight image quality and stabilization assessed; note Good / Average / Poor and any issue.

checks.title: Step 5B — Indoor video
checks.instruction: Record 20–30s office/indoor clip and a person speaking. Review noise/grain, exposure and sharpness.
checks.expected_result: Indoor quality assessed; note Good / Average / Poor and any issue.

checks.title: Step 5C — Low-light video
checks.instruction: Record a short indoor/night-ish clip. Review noise, retained detail and exposure.
checks.expected_result: Low-light quality assessed; note Good / Average / Poor and any issue.

checks.title: Step 6 — Audio test
checks.instruction: Record someone speaking for ~30 seconds. Check voice clarity, buzzing, crackling, dropouts and A/V sync.
checks.expected_result: Audio is clear, synchronized and free of buzzing/crackling/dropouts.

checks.title: Step 7A — File transfer
checks.instruction: Record 3–5 short clips and transfer them to a phone or computer.
checks.expected_result: Files transfer without errors.

checks.title: Step 7B — File integrity/playback
checks.instruction: Play transferred clips fully. Verify video, audio and file integrity.
checks.expected_result: No corrupted files; videos and audio play normally.

checks.title: Step 7C — Storage behaviour
checks.instruction: Check that recording, saving and browsing clips behaves normally and free-space reporting looks plausible.
checks.expected_result: Storage behaves normally with no write/read errors.

checks.title: Step 8 — Final health report
checks.instruction: In the note summarize: Storage GB; camera-only battery min; total useful time with case; temperature; Daylight/Indoor/Low-light/Stabilization ratings; Audio rating; File transfer; Charging case; Physical condition; Working properly = Yes / Warning / No; problems found; possible repair/replacement items. Do not make a purchase decision.
checks.expected_result: Complete factual diagnostic summary entered.
